## [1.4.0](https://github.com/erobertsme/shatteredpixel-morphe-patches/compare/v1.3.0...v1.4.0) (2026-11-22)

### ✨ New Features

* Change an item's type, and weapon and armor tier, in the item editor ([788c971](https://github.com/erobertsme/shatteredpixel-morphe-patches/commit/788c971d44ce50e8a0faad0050e720171fbe1acb))
* Deleting or changing an equipped item in the editor doesn't use a turn ([4025644](https://github.com/erobertsme/shatteredpixel-morphe-patches/commit/4025644ae72eb2e714f5b267f72687f57817b8b1))
* Edit statuses from their info window, status amounts, change a quick tag's action ([a295731](https://github.com/erobertsme/shatteredpixel-morphe-patches/commit/a295731e9ca9f921f7382bc65c06238baf95dcda))
* Fixed-size hero stats tabs, hunger bar on Stats and Run, rename beside info ([9fb1d44](https://github.com/erobertsme/shatteredpixel-morphe-patches/commit/9fb1d4460f6e67286d557eabf07c3f5d3c90fe4c))
* Hero stats on the hero info window, examining your own tile, simpler change type ([134d373](https://github.com/erobertsme/shatteredpixel-morphe-patches/commit/134d373825944421e26db52c8bc4d8b4333fcce5))
* Hero window Edit button in the top right corner ([b4df3e1](https://github.com/erobertsme/shatteredpixel-morphe-patches/commit/b4df3e191054255b29018bd6653be4cb57de0ed4))
* Instant equipment swaps option, and header buttons below long titles ([964eeb9](https://github.com/erobertsme/shatteredpixel-morphe-patches/commit/964eeb94bcb910f7db89b3d16bdea98fa419cd29))
* one status setup for Add Status and quick tags with every setting, and Edit Action on quick tags ([45a5a08](https://github.com/erobertsme/shatteredpixel-morphe-patches/commit/45a5a0854b645d6332802ba0aafe75a8f37fab1e))
* The status editor edits every setting a status keeps ([48cc115](https://github.com/erobertsme/shatteredpixel-morphe-patches/commit/48cc115e8c0b895c96aefb82243a6d36c78e510f))

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* Back works the same from every editor window, smaller depth icon, and the hero marks the tile you stand on ([c80190e](https://github.com/erobertsme/shatteredpixel-morphe-patches/commit/c80190e8fff47fa5b2d73f9806695699853aea40))
* Clean hero stats tabs with a taller scrolling area, readable hunger bar, examining your own tile ([aa5928f](https://github.com/erobertsme/shatteredpixel-morphe-patches/commit/aa5928fbac1065b25d0e7ed2e54be2857995f017))
* Hero stats rows start under the tabs ([0aa54c5](https://github.com/erobertsme/shatteredpixel-morphe-patches/commit/0aa54c562486044649f52604c877c75e2adcbbb3))
* taller hero window with scrolling stats, row icons, and the bottom Edit buttons on Talents and Statuses ([7f90441](https://github.com/erobertsme/shatteredpixel-morphe-patches/commit/7f904413e5dd9eb6113fdf52a0af5415c5edbd26))
